articles.title: Nvidia (NASDAQ
articles.summary: Nvidia reported earnings for Q3 of Fiscal Year 2024. Earnings per share were $4.02, beating analysts' estimates of $3.37 per share. Sales increased by 205.6% year-over-year, reaching $18.12 billion, beating analysts' expectations by $2 billion. For Q4, management expects revenue of $20 billion (+/- 2%). Analysts have a Strong Buy consensus rating on NVDA stock with an average price target of $644.07 per share, implying 28.86% upside potential.

articles.title: Nvidia (NVDA) Reports Earnings Tomorrow. What To Expect
articles.summary: Nvidia is set to report earnings tomorrow. Analysts expect a 172% year-on-year revenue growth to $16.11 billion, with adjusted earnings at $3.39 per share. The company has a history of beating revenue estimates by 5.5% on average. Some of its peers in the processors and graphics chips segment have already reported Q3 earnings results, with Lattice Semiconductor delivering 11.4% year-on-year top-line growth and Allegro MicroSystems reporting 15.9% revenue growth. Nvidia is up 14.9% over the last month and has an analyst price target of $641.9. The company is leading a technological shift in the industry with a 70% year-on-year revenue growth and best-in-class SaaS metrics.

articles.title: Nvidia reports strong Q3 earnings in 2024 (NVDA)
articles.summary: Nvidia reported strong Q3 earnings in 2024 due to increased demand for their graphics processing units for artificial intelligence. Analysts expect the company to grow revenue by 195% in the fiscal fourth quarter. The company also announced the GH200 GPU, which has more memory than the current H100 and an additional Arm processor onboard. The demand for Nvidia's GPUs has increased due to the introduction of the ChatGPT chatbot from Microsoft-backed startup OpenAI.

articles.title: U.S. Stocks Avoid 'Earnings Apocalypse' in November
articles.summary: U.S. stocks have avoided a major drop in earnings this month, which could help them continue to rise. However, a key test is coming on Tuesday with the earnings report of chipmaker Nvidia Corp.

articles.title: Nvidia Earnings
articles.summary: Nvidia will be reporting its third-quarter earnings, with many investors expecting positive results. The company's outlook and performance will be closely watched, especially amid chip export restrictions to China. Industry experts have shared their insights on what to look for in the report, including the company's future prospects, supply constraints, and potential impact on the stock market.
